hub.headline: IRIS GL was SGI's proprietary 3D graphics library and the direct ancestor of OpenGL.
hub.maker: SGI (Silicon Graphics); OpenGL is now kept by the Khronos Group
hub.next: Build a lineage page from IRIS GL to OpenGL and confirm finer details against primary sources.
hub.what_it_was: IRIS GL was SGI's proprietary graphics API. OpenGL was created as an open alternative to it, and the OpenGL specification family (including GLSL, GLX, WGL and GLU) is now maintained by the Khronos Group.
hub.what_survives: IRIS GL source is not public. The Khronos OpenGL Registry publishes the specifications, extensions, headers and an XML API registry, also on GitHub, and the Khronos wiki carries a history of the transition.

name: IRIS GL / OpenGL bridge
summary: Public lineage and standards-registry record for OpenGL's transition from SGI IRIS GL into the Khronos-maintained OpenGL specification ecosystem.
